scope: Short paired four-wheel scripts with solid colliders; independent phase baselines retained. Cases affected by later local road/asset edits refreshed against final source. Unchanged local evidence reused. Surface triangle IDs can change continuously without road ownership changes.

postedSpeedWheeltrace.scope: Paired short integrated four-wheel replays; prescribed speed, integrated steering and vertical dynamics, solid barriers included. Not a whole-corridor driving certification.

limitations: Dongnan S-to-E accurate ribbon contact modestly increases RMS/peak; retained measured values, no contact/safety regression.
Initial 60kph WB short local proposal was inconclusive and replaced by 160m corridor design; history retained at wheeltrace-replay/inconclusive-60kph.json.
WB 60/80kph before trajectories leave the lane and cannot support clean before/after acceleration claims; 30kph pair is valid, final 80kph support/tracking result reported separately.
Phase1 checkpoint height delta retains its original 10Hz meaning; refreshed cases record the corrected per-tick diagnostic.
